newsitem.title: UK: June Brent system throughput stable from May - Shell.
newsitem.headline: June Brent system throughput stable from May - Shell.

text.p: Brent system operator Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Thursday estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in June at 408,806 barrels per day (bpd), down from 409,045 bpd in May.
Shell Expro also said it had cancelled a maintenance shutdown planned for June 22-28 at the 55,000 bpd Tern field, which feeds the Brent system.
Average Brent pipeline throughput in the 12 months to the end of April was 461,555 bpd, Shell said.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.

Brent system throughput includes crude produced from 13 fields and several satellite wells piped to the Sullom Voe terminal in the Shetland Islands, where it is blended with Ninian crude and exported as Brent Blend.
Shell Expro said the throughput forecast was preliminary and may be "subject to significant fluctuation".
